holdings — What is held and what it is worth, as of a date (default today): every account, plus the property, loans and private holdings recorded by hand (a loan is negative). view=global: one row with cash_balance, positions_value and total_value (net worth); it has no per-account columns, so a filter needs another view. sources: per institution. portfolios: per portfolio. accounts: per account with kind, tax wrapper and value. positions: every holding with symbol, quantity and value. Example: {view: "accounts", as_of: "2025-12-31"}.

Parameters (all optional):
  view         global | sources | portfolios | accounts | positions. Which rows to return (default global).
  as_of        As-of date. Default today.
  with_cash    positions only: also list cash as one row per account and currency.
  source       Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.
  account      Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).
  symbol       positions only: keep only holdings whose symbol or name contains this text.
  asset_class  positions only: keep only this asset class (e.g. public_equity, fixed_income, cash, real_estate, crypto).
  tax_wrapper  accounts only: keep only this tax wrapper (e.g. roth_ira, 401k, 529, taxable_joint).
  missing_basis ignore | zero. positions only: a missing cost basis is blank (ignore, the default) or counts as 0 (zero); the config's lots.missing_basis sets the default.
  currency     Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.
  filter       Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].
  search       Keep rows with this text in any cell.
  columns      "default", "all", names, or "+add,-remove"; describe(topic=<tool>) lists them.
  sort         Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.
  max_chars    Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.
  limit        Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).
  offset       Rows to skip (default 0).
  format       table | csv | json. Result format (default table).

Columns (* = shown by default; columns=all shows every one):
  global: min_snapshot_date*, max_snapshot_date*, cash_balance_USD*, positions_value_USD*, total_value_USD*
  sources: silver_source*, snapshot_date*, valued_date, observed_date, base_currency*, tax_wrapper*, management_style*, positions_value*, cash_balance*, total_value*, positions_value_USD, cash_balance_USD, total_value_USD*
  portfolios: silver_source*, snapshot_date*, portfolio*, portfolio_id, base_currency*, relationship_id, portfolio_nickname, tax_wrapper*, management_style*, positions_value*, cash_balance*, total_value*, positions_value_USD, cash_balance_USD, total_value_USD*
  accounts: silver_source*, snapshot_date*, account*, account_id, account_kind*, tax_wrapper*, management_style*, base_currency*, relationship_id, account_nickname, account_category, portfolio_external_id, positions_value*, cash_balance*, total_value*, positions_value_USD, cash_balance_USD, total_value_USD*
  positions: silver_source*, snapshot_date*, valued_date, account*, account_id, position_key*, symbol*, name, asset_class*, vehicle*, currency*, quantity*, market_value*, value_USD*, cost_basis, cost_basis_USD, unrealized_gain, unrealized_gain_USD, unrealized_pct, basis_stamp, quantity_without_basis, acquisition_date, accrued_interest, clean_value, relationship_id, account_nickname, account_category

Filters each view takes (a filter the view lacks moves the call to the first finer view that has it):
  global: none
  sources: source
  portfolios: source
  accounts: source, account, tax_wrapper
  positions: source, account, symbol, asset_class

Totals reconcile: global = sum of sources = sum of portfolios = sum of accounts = positions with with_cash. A loan or a card balance is negative. positions_value, cash_balance and total_value are in each account's own currency; the columns with a currency suffix are converted.
Example: {view: "accounts", tax_wrapper: "roth_ira"}.

This endpoint redacts amounts, quantities, account numbers and the names taken off statements (merchants, payers, narratives), and shows a name a person typed about an account as a pseudonym such as manual-1, or as its account number, redacted; source ids, other account names, holdings and their names, categories and shares stay visible.
